notes: Intrinsic instructions execute natively beneath delegated effective state and are never ambiently intercepted. Domain construction uses generation-threaded unpublished builders; rare workflows compose general lifecycle, observation, state-stream, and handoff primitives.
The typed-family inventory in §16.0, object catalog in §17.7, and operand map in §17.10 define the current encoding.

jumps, branches, enforced landing pads, conditional traps

gates, endpoints, typed authority/domain families (0xac reserved), memory operations, PCR, environment-description streams, and random
class-specific opcodes; 0xbb..0xc8 and 0xcf are the existing typed families; 0xc9 is Device
set, cursor, state transport, observation, lifecycle

v.int v.fp v.mem v.mask v.perm v.red (funcs frozen by number, §18.1)
reserved, named: vector crypto block (AES round ops, SHA compression, GHASH/clmul-based widening)

v.ff — 0 ldff (fault-only-first unit-stride load, landed 2026-07-13, §18); vector-ABI ops 1 cntvb, 2 cntve, 3 addvl (landed 2026-07-14, §18); funcs 4-63 reserved: segment/structure loads, element-granular runtime permute

amo_funcs.floating_funcs_note: 12-14 are the C++/Rust floating RMWs (fadd/fmin/fmax), f32/f64 via the family size field. SHIPPED IN V1 (2026-07-11), mandatory like every other amo func — NOT FEATURES-negotiated (there is no optional instruction, §1; they ride the whole-FP view grant like scalar fadd). fadd uses default rounding RNE (no rm field in the amo encoding); fmin/fmax follow IEEE 754-2019 minimum/maximum (§14); no FP trap, status flags accrue (§6). | FLAG-SILENT (2026-07-14): funcs 12-14 accrue no IEEE status flags and raise no trap, in any form — the op executes at the data's home where the thread FCSR does not exist, and the posted form has no reply to carry flags (one rule for all forms; rounding fixed RNE)
amo_funcs.cas_failure_ordering: ford[25:24] on funcs 10 cas / 11 casq only (0 inherit, 1 relaxed, 2 acquire, 3 seq_cst; assigned 2026-07-30; reserved-reject on every other func). On failure the op takes effect as a load at the ford ordering — ford=3 is an sc-marked member of S, mirroring the .sc refinement; on success ord/sc apply unchanged; ford=0 keeps the v1 join semantics so existing binaries are untouched. Strengthening is always conforming: join(ord, ford) at decode is a legal implementation. cmpxchg lowering: ord/sc = success ordering, ford = failure ordering — the split-ordering concession is retired (completeness_inversions.md table 3). Mandatory litmus seeds: MP-fail, SB-fail, inherit-equivalence (§6).

subformats.note: A reviewer observed that the declared subformat irregularities (sel cc[27:26] vs fsel cc[29:28]; ldx vs stx scale/fp homes; bext vs bins descriptor forms; the amo family home vs the futex outsider) mean an assembler/disassembler 'cannot be table-driven from one rule'. Correct - and the answer is that it is table-driven from THIS CATALOG, not from one rule: this section is the single source the tools generate from. Per the §16.6 clause 3 normativity split, these are frozen-encoding facts (normative as prose+table in lnp64_isa.md), transcribed here for generation.

base_formats.slot_rule: register slots occupy fixed positions regardless of role; a slot a format does not use is zero (§1); an opcode may claim an unused slot as an operation field (extended subformat)

R.operands: rd, rs1[, rs2[, rs3[, rs4[, rs5]]]]

hint_zones.ref: §12 (v1 hint catalog, bit assignments frozen; any value decodes, timing only, never a result)

branches_B[8:0].[4:2]: weight bucket: 0 none, 1-7 PGO probability octile
branches_B[8:0].[5]: kill-rs1 (last read of rs1; death hint, 2026-07-13)
branches_B[8:0].[8:7]: reserved — spoken for in spirit: TRIP_COUNT (loop trip-count buckets on backward branches), reserved by name, assigned only by revision

loads_I[13:0]_stores_S[8:0].[1:0]: temporal locality: 0 default, 1 non-temporal/streaming, 2 last-use; stores 3 = dead-after-write (loads 3 reserved) — licence is writeback/eviction timing ONLY, line stays fully coherent-visible: not-re-read-by-me is never not-re-read-by-anyone (coherent DMA readers see stored data exactly as unmarked)
loads_I[13:0]_stores_S[8:0].note: loads' [13:7] reserved; kill idiom: ori rN, rN, 0 with hint zone = 1 means rN dead (assembler: kill rN); death-hint doctrine: timing only, reads of dead-marked state stay defined (§12)

hint_zones.amo_family[1:0]: placement: 0 none, 1 near-biased, 2 far-biased (§6 far-execution contention hint), 3 reserved

W_bit.meaning: R-format extended-subformat bit W: operate on low 32 bits of sources, sign-extend result to 64 (shift/rotate amounts mod 32); exists only in the R format (§4.1)

U_bit.meaning: extended-subformat bit U (.uw spellings): zero-extend rs1[31:0] before the shift/add (§4.1)

shared_conventions.W_and_U: [1:0] = 11 is reserved -> illegal-instruction on every op defining both bits (§4.1)

atomic_family_home.ref: §6: one subfield home for the whole atomic family, pinned
atomic_family_home.doctrine: an op whose width or ordering is fixed by its opcode simply does not decode the field; the futexes are the one declared outsider (futex_requeue occupies all six register slots, so [30:26] is physically unavailable) - one home, one diagram, one declared outsider, no floating fields

fp_subformat.ref: §14: FP arithmetic uses the R-format extended subformat; exact subfield bits in the [25:0] region
fp_subformat.fmt: [25:24] (00 binary32 .s, 01 binary64 .d, 10 binary16 .h, 11 bfloat16 .bf; narrow code points are storage/convert-only - arithmetic with fmt=.h/.bf is illegal-instruction)
fp_subformat.rm: [23:21] (000 RNE, 001 RTZ, 010 RDN, 011 RUP, 100 RMM, 111 DYN = use FCSR.frm; DYN is an instruction encoding only)
fp_subformat.intw: [20:19] (fcvt.f2i/fcvt.i2f only: 00 w, 01 wu, 10 l, 11 lu; fmt gives the FP side)
fp_subformat.rest: [16:0] reserved-zero except where a row in the §14 table assigns a bit (fcvt.f2i's [16] = mod is the one assignment today)

0xf1.name: v.fp
0xf1.fcvt_width_note: funcs 16/17: equal element width in the base form (dt[16:14]=0); nonzero dt enrolls the two hot mixed-width pairs under the width-change rule — fcvt.f2i.b/.t f64->i32 (truncating narrow, §14 exact saturation) and fcvt.i2f.b/.t i32->f64 (exact widen); any other dt/etype pair reserved -> illegal-instruction (2026-07-30)
0xf1.fcmp_note: func 19 cc set: quiet eq/ne/uo, signaling lt/le; one/ueq are the named composed pair (2 compares + 1 mask op, target_tuning_note.md)
0xf1.half_format_rule: etype f16/bf16 are convert-only lane types: legal only as fcvt.f2f source/destination (§14 pairs per lane); every other v.fp func at a half etype is reserved -> illegal-instruction. Mirrors §14: no half-precision arithmetic exists on the machine, scalar or vector — half is storage, f32/f64 is compute

0xf3.name: v.mask
0xf3.whileltc_note: funcs 14/15 (assigned 2026-07-30): the counted while — the func-0/1 predicate to the mask destination AND the active-lane count to a GPR named in the vs3 slot [40:36] (stx slot-naming precedent); u[16] as for funcs 0/1. Pinned: count = mpopc of the produced mask exactly (zero-extended; clamp(bound - index, 0, lanes) by the prefix-mask semantics); zero active lanes -> all-false mask and count 0, no fault. A count, never a boolean flag. A genuine two-result primitive (§16.2); backedge = whileltc; bne

0xf7.name: v.ff
0xf7.note: fault-only-first unit-stride load: count of successfully loaded elements written to the GPR slot-named in rs2 (no VL state — the count goes where every result goes, a GPR); lanes past the first faulting element zero-filled; fault at element 0 faults normally (progress guarantee); stores deliberately have no fault-first form | vector-ABI ops (2026-07-14, §18): cntvb rd = VLEN bytes; cntve rd {etype} = lane count at element width; addvl rd, rs1, imm17 = rs1 + sext(imm17)*(VLEN/8) (per-family area [16:0]) — GPR-result ops, result slot-named in vd, source GPR in vs1; addvl + unit-stride vl/vst is a blessed fusion pair (the scaled-addressing form as a fusion license)

0xf5.name: v.red
0xf5.dot_family_removal_note: sdot/udot/fdot (formerly funcs 14-16) DELETED 2026-08-01 per the §18 Role charter: the closed consumer list (datacenter tax + compiler-found parallelism) excludes CPU-side inference, the dot family's only consumer — an attached-engine workload (§15). Composed lowering: widening multiplies feeding red.sum/fred.sum. Pre-freeze deletion, no ghosts; funcs return to reserved

consumers: loop/SLP shapes a production vectorizer finds in ordinary code
charter.rule: a new vector op must name its consumer in this closed list AND both GCC and LLVM default pipelines must vectorize the loop/IR shape it lowers (the intersection rule - one compiler is not a consumer; deletion is early and eager). The op is this target's lowering of the shape; target hooks this backend sets (tail-folding preference) count as the default pipeline. VLEN growth requires a charter consumer unserved at the current width - throughput is never that argument
charter.throughput_disposition: inference, GEMM-class, media transcode, streaming: attached-engine workloads behind gates (§15), permanently — the matrix position generalized
charter.client: the compiler, solely: GCC/LLVM default pipelines (loop/SLP vectorizers, loop-idiom recognition, builtin expansion). Admission = charter workload AND compiler-emitted IR shape (completeness_inversions.md table 2 is the admission universe). No stable intrinsics surface exists or is promised (psABI); no op is admitted for a human consumer
charter.intersection_deletions: no lane-wise clmul/clmulh (scalar §4 clmul is the CRC story, both pipelines target it); no compress/viota (filter-loop compress-store is not a shape either default pipeline vectorizes; masked-store form is the lowering)

gate.stack.note: each slot is 16-byte aligned; bytes 0..127 are the pinned ActivationContext, bytes 128..align16(128+inline_area_len)-1 are the shared-phase inline/reply area, and the remaining >=16 bytes are the downward-growing handler stack; seal rejects overflow or insufficient space

gate.serve.note: current persistent thread binds itself as the sole worker and atomically increments ready_counter before parking; failure returns without changing the Counter; each call writes the ActivationContext into the declared handler slot's reserved 128-byte prefix, runs gate.entry on the remaining disposable stack, and gate_return reparks the serve continuation

getter_result_abi.rule: scalar facts use class-specific raw getters; unknown selectors fault and all 64 result bits are data. Collections use cursors and records, never a universal getter.
getter_result_abi.traffic_counter_overflow: modular at 2^64 (wrapping), deliberately unlike the saturating counters of the one temporal primitive (§3); traffic getters are observational deltas, so consumers subtract successive reads in unsigned arithmetic and a single wrap between reads is transparent

execution_class_declarations.rule: ENUMERATE reports execution class per operation or facet; real-time admission accepts only HW_BOUNDED

state_composition.rule: rare workflows are compositions, not instruction classes; no dmigrate.*, dfreeze, dthaw, domain-specific export, or domain-specific import instruction exists

class_declarations.FileDescription: REBIND_REQUIRED unless explicit service profile declares PROXYABLE

state_composition.cell_repoint: the expected target remains authoritative before commit; commit conditionally repoints exactly one epoch-cell edge; failure or abort leaves it unchanged; no plans, participants, callbacks, or policy are accepted
state_composition.serialization_admission_rule: no object class, sub-op, or semantic feature lands in any revision without declaring at introduction: transfer-contract class, section/record schema+version, required-vs-optional classification (derived state OPTIONAL or absent), external-dependency enumeration, partial-activity disposition (restart/drain recipe), destination-compatibility predicate; inadmissible otherwise (§16.8)

serialization_admission_registry._note: The six admission answers §16.8 requires of every class, structured per class so the gate can check all six rather than only the transfer contract. Fields 2-6 are structured from §16.8/§17.9 normative prose; where the prose states a rule globally rather than per class, the record says 'global (§16.8)' and inherits it. Adding a class without a complete record here is inadmissible (§16.8), and the gate enforces that.

MSG_CAPS_MAX.note: one constant machine-wide: caps per message, dgrantm/dspawn transfer mask, and the gate max_cap_transfer ceiling

DOMAIN_TAG_CAPACITY.note: architectural floor 256 live tags; this is not an 8-bit architectural field: tags are engine-private and implementations may use wider tags, epochs, indirection, or sharing; retag recycling invalidates at domain-tag granularity, never whole-TLB

ATOMIC_WRITE_BOUND.queryable: per-endpoint via channel fixed getter; machine floor in env_open GEOMETRY
ATOMIC_WRITE_BOUND.note: Architectural floor 512 B pinned in 10.1 (PIPE_BUF precedent, 2026-07-11: F9 resolved)

HANDLE_EPOCH_WIDTH.note: corrected 2026-07-17 (checker-tightening pass): stale 31 predated the FR5 handle-split rebalance 32/31 -> 24/39; spec Sec2.2 = slot [62:39], epoch [38:0]

INVALIDATION_ACK_BOUND.note: tight bound: coherence-fabric participants (cores, TLBs, IOMMU walk paths); device-class recourse is ATS_ACK_BOUND — see §11.2 normative ordering (fence engaged and fabric-acked before the op returns). PARAMETRIC IN VOLUME (2026-07-13, Law 8): the served value states the bound for the answering MachineView's volume diameter; broadcast scope = owning domain's volume, ack = spanning-tree reduction rooted at the cell's home (§3), O(log volume)

ATS_ACK_BOUND.note: device-class ack bound, inherited only by ops whose range is mapped into an ATS-granted device window; miss ⇒ fence at fabric ingress, window cells poisoned, fence-synthesized -POISONED completions; RT admission must budget it or keep RT ranges out of ATS-granted windows

SGL_MAX.note: SGL entries per DMA CopyV descriptor; snapshot-validated whole pre-effect; the iovec family's bound

PAGE_SIZE.note: one architectural page size; env_open reports it for interface uniformity

LARGE_LEAF_SIZE.note: the one additional leaf size (512 pages at the 4 KiB page); map.leaf selects it during unpublished construction; map.demote losslessly splits 1 leaf charge into 512 page charges

TIMEBASE_SKEW_BOUND.note: Law 8/Law 4 (2026-07-13): timebase is per-volume, monotone within a coherence volume, skew-bounded across; a tick_quantum_shift coarser than this bound makes the skew unobservable

handle_format.epoch: [38:0], 39 bits, slot embedded-cell check value; epoch 0 reserved-invalid at every width
handle_format.null_theorem: live handle = slot<<39 | epoch with epoch>=1, so u64 0 is unconstructible as a live handle
handle_format.note: saturated-slot count is charged visible accounting state; per-domain tables scope exhaustion to the churning domain

GATE_WARM_RTT.note: per-machine published warm-path round-trip bound under the §9.2 measured-path preconditions; deliberately never an architectural constant

SPAWN_WARM_RTT.note: bounds both empty dnew-through-dseal publication and dspawn issue to first child instruction under inherited-view, shared-compartment, no-admission/no-measurement/no-binding warm preconditions; includes eager domain materialization

DESTROY_WARM.note: dkill issue through its class-1 return; asynchronous corpse reclamation excluded and corpse-charged

GATE_RESIDENCY_LEASES.note: resident capacity: leases pinning gate resolution/metadata/translation/activation-slot resident for ledger-covered RT paths

FAULT_WARM_RTT.note: per-machine published warm machine-call round-trip bound (faulting boundary to first handler instruction plus gate_return 0 resume) under the §9.3 preconditions: registered gate + activation stack resident and pinned, GPR-class handler, VEC_PRESENT clear, same agent, no contention; the warm gate plus the bounded payload write

env_open_header.name: env_open record header
env_open_header.note: record_type numeric assignments are §17.6's: 0 ISA_VERSION, 1 GEOMETRY, 2 TOPOLOGY, 3 FEATURES, 4 TIMEBASE, 5 STARTUP; 6+ reserved additive

completion_record.name: Completion record

fields.name: status
fields.note: status is 0 or a negative §13.1 condition in the single architectural error namespace

fields.name: value
fields.note: fixed producer-class interpretation: for example gate retval or DMA bytes_done; the record shape never varies

completion_record.note: The producer class fixes the meaning of value; CompletionQueue never negotiates or returns a selector-dependent record schema.

fields.name: access
fields.note: 0 read, 1 write, 2 execute, 3 write-to-clean

fields.name: width
fields.note: 0 page-granular; otherwise 1,2,4,8

fields.name: faulting_domain
fields.note: opaque backing-local cookie, never a foreign domain name and never reused for another domain during the backing incarnation

fields.name: request_id
fields.note: nonzero generation-qualified backing-local id, never reused during the backing incarnation

fields.name: store_value
fields.note: zero unless width-qualified write

fields.name: cause
fields.note: 0 step, 1 watchpoint, 2 trap (imm in aux), 3 routed-fatal-fault (cause in aux)

fields.name: frame_index
fields.note: youngest = 0

fields.name: kind
fields.note: 0 domain gate, 1 machine call

fields.name: flags
fields.note: bit0 DETACHED, bit1 CANCELLATION

fields.name: flags
fields.note: bit0 measured form, bit1 suspended-time policy, bit2 METADATA_ONLY inspection stream; bits [31:3] reserved-zero; import rejects bit2

fields.name: target_revision
fields.note: ISA revision whose schemas bound every section version; 0 = producer's own (§16.8 decades rule)

fields.name: capture_id
fields.note: fresh and never reused in the source-object incarnation

fields.name: source_cut_tick
fields.note: cut binding/audit only; never a cross-machine elapsed-time authority

fields.name: section_type
fields.note: 1 VIEWS, 2 CAPTABLE, 3 ADDRESS_SPACE, 4 THREADS, 5 ENGINE_STATE, 6 CHILDREN, 7 DEPENDENCIES; 8-255 reserved type numbers; bit31 = OPTIONAL flag (only reconstructible derived state; unknown optional sections are skipped whole)

serialization_dependencies_v1.name: architectural state-stream DEPENDENCIES v1 header
serialization_dependencies_v1.note: typed external requirements live in the owning CAPTABLE/object dependency table and are satisfied with state.bind

machine_call_payload.name: machine-call argument payload (§17.5)

fields.name: flags
fields.note: FP_PRESENT=1, SYNC_FAULT=2, INSN_VALID=4, OP_RESTARTABLE=8, VEC_PRESENT=16, MAT_PRESENT=32 reserved

fields.name: fault_insn
fields.note: valid iff INSN_VALID

fields.name: decode
fields.note: [4:0] rd, [9:5] rs1, [14:10] rs2, [19:15] rs3, [20] writes-GPR(0)/FPR(1), [28:21] opcode, [29] fmt low bit, [32:30] rm, [34:33] intw, [36:35] fmt(2-bit); valid iff INSN_VALID

fields.name: orig_rd_value
fields.note: valid iff OP_RESTARTABLE

fields.name: context_live_mask
fields.note: v1 is UINT64_MAX; bits 0..31 correspond to r0..r31 and bits 32..63 to f0..f31; FP bits are ignored when FP_PRESENT is clear

fields.name: fcsr
fields.note: iff FP_PRESENT

fields.name: fprs
fields.note: f0..f31, [328..584), iff FP_PRESENT

machine_call_payload.note: vector region follows when VEC_PRESENT, sized 32*VLEN + 16*VLEN/8 bits from geometry

fields.name: bytes_len
fields.note: in; in/out for recv

fields.name: caps_ptr
fields.note: caps-array element bit63 = DROP_ON_IMAGE_REPLACE on transfer paths

fields.name: caps_len
fields.note: in/out

fields.name: bytes_len
fields.note: in: outbound length; out: actual reply length

fields.name: caps_len
fields.note: in: outbound count; out: actual reply count

fields.name: borrow_ptr
fields.note: 0 = no borrow; else -> 48 B two-window borrow descriptor (§17.1c)

activation_context.name: gate ActivationContext addressed by entry r2
activation_context.note: engine writes before entry and never reads back; address is in r2, seven user words are r3-r9, r10-r13 are zero, and the buffer never aliases tp/TLS or the handler stack

fields.name: rights0
fields.note: bit0 READ, bit1 WRITE, others reserved-zero; execute never grantable

fields.name: base1
fields.note: all-zero window 1 = one-window form; window 1 without window 0 is -MALFORMED; windows may not overlap

fields.name: rights1
fields.note: same bit meanings as rights0

iovec_element.name: I/O vector element
iovec_element.note: iov_ptr and iov_count are separate register operands; no operation-wide fields occur in the sequence

fields.name: member_id
fields.note: waitset-local; permanently retired by DEL_MEMBER and never reused in the waitset incarnation

typed_family_subformat.name: fixed typed-family instruction subformat
typed_family_subformat.note: This is an instruction word, not a memory record. Opcode[63:56], rd/rs1..rs5 use the base R format and every typed family uses func[7:0]. Hardware-object class is fixed by opcode. Unassigned low bits are reserved-zero.

dma_copyhash_descriptor.name: DMA CopyHash work descriptor
dma_copyhash_descriptor.note: SHA-256 is valid only on complete success; the typed facet selects this operation

fields.name: flags (bit0 CONTENTS_LOST, bit1 SHARED_MAPPERS, bit2 RETIREMENT_COMPLETE, bit3 RECOVERY_COMPLETE, bit4 ACKNOWLEDGED)

dmawindow_remap_extent.name: DMAWindow REMAP extent
dmawindow_remap_extent.note: extent_ptr and extent_count are separate register operands; same backing/rights/direction as committed by window.seal; snapshot-validated whole pre-effect; installed atomically; returns repoint_generation in rd; window.acknowledged carries acquire semantics; backing_offset UINT64_MAX = UNMAPPED; generation saturates and never wraps; serialization requires issued==acked with zero transients

env_open_bodies.length_rule: header.length is the total record length including the 16-byte header
env_open_bodies.TOPOLOGY: concatenated 64-byte topology records in MachineView order

features.note: FEATURES bit positions are catalog-assigned per §16.6 clause 3; only the names below are reserved in lnp64_isa.md. This file IS the catalog, so positions are assigned here.

fli_table.note: frozen 32-entry constant table (14, RISC-V Zfa adopted verbatim; enumerated in-spec 2026-07-11: F3 resolved)

classes.ENC: encoding space only, no semantic promise
classes.DVP: deferred versioned profile (named, interaction constraints frozen, nothing normative rests on it)

reserved_seam_register.rule: 'reserved by name' without an Appendix G register row is not a legal spec state; an ENC seam cited normatively outside its reservation is misclassified

seams.FUTEX_EXTENSION: ENC (undifferentiated futex/scheduler growth seam: any future futex-class mechanism - PI, robust assist, waiter morphing - arrives whole (mechanism + word convention + identity + teardown + volume-local locality rule), never format-first; B20 records the refusal, FR48 deleted the half-frozen word ABI, and the pre-deployment selector compaction left no PI_IDENT tombstone; nothing in v1 cites it)
seams.MATRIX_PROFILE: ENC (reserved context words only; stated direction is the attached device-backed matrix engine)
seams.GATE_AFFINITY: DVP (runtime sensor half; psABI static metadata is the feed-forward half)
seams.PRI_PASID_SVA: DVP + market statement (v1 accelerator target = pinned/windowed DMA; SVA outside v1's target market by decision; DECIDED: GPU-class accelerators integrate as devices under the DeviceProxy contract — per-context isolation is PASID-class sub-requester identities through this seam; GPU-contexts-as-domains is rejected for GPUs, not deferred)
seams.DEVICE_ISSUED_ATOMICS: DVP (must join the existing far-execution ordering model)
seams.DEVICE_BACKED_DOMAINS: DVP (predicate frozen: holds capabilities -> domain; scope decided: not the GPU path — remains for the attached-engine shape (§18 matrix position) and masters that genuinely host capability-checking execution)
seams.CACHE_INJECTION: ENC (hint-class; §12 ignore-safe is its only semantic)
seams.MEMORY_COLORING: ENC (B31 governs: nothing may cite it)
seams.TRIP_COUNT: ENC (hint-zone name; §12 ignore-safe is its only semantic)
seams.CACHE_PARTITION: ENC (separately named typed builder instruction reserved by name; prime+probe occupancy channel deferred to the noninterference track; B31 rule - nothing may cite it until designed)
seams.LATENCY_HINT: ENC (separately named future scheduling operand/function; share and latency-preference are independent; nothing may cite it until designed)
seams.PRESSURE: ENC (PMU PRESSURE profile reserved by name: per-cause stall classes, PSI 'full' overlap accounting, threshold-triggered wakeups; the fixed mem_stall_ticks getter is deliberately some-only; standing justification = EXHAUSTION-waitable fires on budget events, later than a stall-rate crossing)
seams.SHARDED_EXPORT: ENC (parallel/sharded serialization sections reserved by name, Sec16.8: for a domain whose metadata outgrows one sequential stream - data was never the stream's job (big-domain doctrine: contents ride per-backing clone/persist/post-copy, stream is O(objects) thin); frozen constraint: shards commit as one atomic import under the nothing-retained rule; nothing in v1 cites it)
seams.CELL_JOIN: ENC (derived epoch cells reserved by name, Sec3: epoch = monotone join of named parents, one check validates a composite cached fact; frozen constraints - parents named at mint, join monotone, saturation dominant, stated broadcast home, full Sec16.4 fan-in accounting; nothing in v1 cites it, N independent checks are the v1 truth)
seams.RET_PROTECT: DVP (intra-domain return-address protection, §2/§7/B32: today ra is pure convention — jal/jalr write any rd, hardware never assumes r1. Frozen interaction constraints: (1) any future hardware backward-edge protection binds to r1 — the freeze is deliberate and r1-shaped; nothing else may claim that meaning; (2) it binds to the r1 ROLE and return-shape recognition (jalr r0, r1-class), never to the instructions — jal rd/jalr rd generality for non-return uses is preserved. Until it lands, returns stay conventional and intra-domain backward-edge protection is software's; nothing in v1 cites it)
seams.BANDWIDTH_PARTITION: ENC (MPAM-class fabric/DRAM bandwidth partitioning: no architected dimension — budgets meter bytes/compute, CACHE_PARTITION covers occupancy, PRESSURE covers telemetry, none covers bandwidth reservation. First recorded pressure: integrated-GPU scanout vs CPU traffic on one DRAM controller. Nothing may cite it until designed — the B31 rule)
seams.EXTENDED_RIGHTS: ENC (rights-word growth, §17.7: a per-class extended-rights page reached through the entry, reserved by name so exhaustion of the 32-bit word never forces reinterpretation of an assigned bit; nothing may cite it until designed — the B31 rule)
seams.GATE_CAPARGS: DVP (activation-scoped capability references remain deferred on the §2.2 second-namespace question; persistent invocation capability transfer uses the message descriptor, and nothing may cite this seam until designed)

gates_and_machine_calls.mechanism: gate_call/gate_return, FAULT/EVENT machine calls - control crosses protection boundaries only through gates, no second delivery mechanism

delivery_targeting.mechanism: responsible-party routing: fault to faulter, page request to pager, cancellation to callee, debug event to debugger

cancellation_teardown.mechanism: ordered cancellation/teardown flow - unwind delivered through the gate model

donation_charging.mechanism: donation as a held reference to a reservation, validated live: chain ID + donated-reservation handle, revoked at detach, failing closed when the chain dies. Reassigned from Law 1 (2026-07-17, the artifact's first filed bug): 'donation is dataflow' is Law-1 clothing, but the mechanism's essence is Law 2's shape - a time-qualified held reference

capability_slots_and_handles.mechanism: capabilities as held references: unforgeable, domain-local, epoch-validated, re-keyed at transfer

epoch_cells.mechanism: the one temporal primitive - a monotone saturating counter under two check disciplines: the cell (equality/freshness, bump-invalidate broadcast) and the generation (>=/progress, cumulative ack - REMAP repoints, writegen.rotate and dirty cursors, lease ids, poison, submission handles); shared theorems stated once in Sec3; CELL_JOIN seam reserved as the freshness discipline's completion

revocation_lineage.mechanism: cap_revoke via shared lineage cells - all descendants at once, O(1) bump

translation_freshness.mechanism: VMA epoch cells + acknowledged invalidation broadcast; caching doctrine (memoization against a cell)

service_stamps_restamp.mechanism: a minted service object has one per-object stamp shared by its aliases: Gate route, class, opaque object cookie, and lifecycle queue; RESTAMP atomically repoints that object and returns an alias; moving capture records a REBIND_REQUIRED external dependency and imports a live replacement of the same service-owned class without serializing route, cookie, queue, or service-private state

pin_leases.mechanism: lease_id generation validation - Law 2 binds identifiers even where no authority rides them

lending_lifetimes.mechanism: three modalities over one linear resource: message transit, table entry, activation frame - the holder structure is the revocation

engine_reference_lifetimes.mechanism: four explicit object-edge types orthogonal to cell referent_count; deterministic bounded aggregation drain; cycles remain charged and revocable without tracing collection or unsafe reuse

engines_as_substrate.mechanism: intrinsic instructions execute natively beneath delegated effective state; engines hold no authority and all authority descends from the reset grant to the first ordinary domain; services are explicit gates/endpoints/proxies, never ambient instruction interception

device_one_ontology.mechanism: hardware and software objects are one thing at different latencies: DeviceProxy/QueuePortal planes, pagers, served protocols

timebase_and_ticks.mechanism: one monotonic timebase; ticks are the only architectural unit; nanoseconds exist only at the serialization boundary

clockview_wall_time.mechanism: every other clock is a view: the affine {offset, slew} ClockView with its embedded epoch cell

cross_volume_time.mechanism: per-volume timebase with bounded skew; the global order is the engine-edge transitive closure (happened-before from silicon)

preemption_everywhere.mechanism: every instruction boundary preempts; no multi-instruction or software-created non-preemptible region exists, and the longest indivisible interval is one instruction bounded by its published class and parameters

no_os_nouns.mechanism: personalities are software; service-profile bodies are opaque to silicon; no POSIX noun below the preamble

five_views.mechanism: the five monotone views, subset-image composition (affine monoid action + meet-semilattice confluence), the view-lattice fixed point

domain_local_names.mechanism: subtree-scoped IDs, re-keyed handles, engine records carry only domain-local names

budgets_and_admission.mechanism: budgets/reservations as a view dimension: monotone carving, per-domain admission, no global utilization ledger

thread_sched_envelope.mechanism: SET_THREAD_SCHED orders within the domain's envelope - the subset-image rule applied to scheduling; priorities are domain-local names

observer_scoped_telemetry.mechanism: observer-pays telemetry, view-scoped counters, no cross-domain performance oracle

serialization_roundtrip.mechanism: state.commit(state.import(state.open(D,FULL))) equivalent to D under Law-7 observation; capture/restore/migration are software compositions of general primitives

locality_classes.mechanism: near/far classes, volume-confined sharing, windows - the far-load lie made unconstructible

locality_metric.mechanism: the view-local hierarchical distance - an ultrametric, whose nested-balls property is the containment tree

placement_and_migration.mechanism: domain.place immutable sets, backing.rehome invariants, connected-region rule

distance_priced_costs.mechanism: every cost class carries its distance annotation; nothing is O(machine diameter)

location_is_physical.mechanism: the memory model's location is the backing frame, never the virtual name - physical truth under aliasing

state_matrix.operation_source: per-class opcode functions + typed families + data_plane_operations
state_matrix.normal_cell: transition:OPERATION_LOCAL_SEMANTICS (the operation row remains the single source for ordinary configuration/argument preconditions)
state_matrix.rule: The checker materializes every class x operation x object_state x concurrent_event x event_phase cell. State precedence, then an exact override, then the interference rule yields exactly one typed outcome; blank, multiply resolved, or unknown outcomes fail.

pagedbacking_supply.anchor: installation of the validated frame extent

engine_reference_model.classification_rule: Every engine-held object relationship schema names exactly one edge type. Absence, multiple classification, or implementation-selected classification is invalid. Edge type governs object lifetime; qualifying_cell_referent independently governs epoch-cell metadata lifetime.
engine_reference_model.design_heuristic: Design an edge weak unless retaining the target is necessary to fulfill an already committed architectural promise; the frozen binding, not this heuristic, is normative.

strong_transfer.release: consume, clear, explicit destroy, or defining lifetime end

transient_strong.release: exactly once at accepted operation terminal teardown

weak_observation.release: unregister, target death/stale processing, observer destroy, or source teardown

backpointer_index.release: removed by the source relation that created it

engine_reference_model.cell_referent_rule: A relationship may retain qualifying epoch-cell metadata regardless of object edge type. That metadata increments referent_count and never by itself increments the target object's strong_reference_count.
engine_reference_model.cycle_rule: Strong edges may form cycles. Cycles are charged bounded retention, not temporal-safety exceptions: revocation and poison remain effective, explicit destroy drains one bounded aggregation without graph traversal, and storage or identity reuse waits for strong and transient users to release.

sponsorship.domain_teardown: Drain domain-bound aggregations and edges owned by the dying domain. Do not destroy an externally retained shared object unless its mint-time contract is explicitly sponsor-bound; otherwise retain existing corpse accounting until normal release.

notifications.LAST_STRONG_REFERENCE: No stamped strong object reference remains after accepted dispatches quiesce; not tracing reachability and may be delayed by a strong cycle.

engine_reference_model.verification: Bindings are injective. Tests instantiate every binding, check object and cell counters independently, and exercise cyclic queues, weak waitsets, weak service routes, reverse-map backpointers, transient teardown, explicit aggregation drain, and domain teardown with external holders.

compiler_semantics.scope: Compiler effects exclude the universal possibility of illegal/disabled-opcode delivery. may_fault and may_deliver_machine_call describe the assigned operation's own semantics. Generated rows are defaults merged with exactly one effect class and then any named operation override.

gate_call.defines_registers_note: gate_call architecturally writes the return sentinel (0xFFFF_FFFF_FFFF_FFF8) into r1/ra at activation, exactly as jal defines its link register; model it as a register def so the clobber is derived mechanically, never from a hand-written inline-asm clobber list (§9.2; the engine installs the same sentinel in ra at machine-call delivery (§9.3), so machine-call handlers are ordinary functions ending in ret as well)

compiler_semantics.intrinsic_admission_rule: A target intrinsic exists only when an operation's control-flow, memory, engine-state, ordering, or authority effect cannot be represented correctly by an existing intrinsic or an ordinary external call carrying the resolved attributes. New typed functions and service profiles do not create intrinsics by default.
compiler_semantics.resolution_rule: Every name in opcode_map.opcodes occurs exactly once across opcode_effect_bindings. Every hardware-owned typed function occurs exactly once across typed_operation_effect_bindings. Merge defaults, the named effect class, and at most one operation override; the result must contain every required_fields key. Service-owned profile bodies are outside this table and use their declared typed-interface summary or the conservative gate external-effect row.

authority_data_separation.theorem: authority operations (cap.* slot ops, mem_grant, dself, waitset membership, builder facts) neither read nor write ordinary memory contents beyond explicitly named descriptor/buffer operands; ordinary loads/stores move freely across them; two authority ops on different objects commute
exceptions: map.protect/munmap_range/map.demote: accessibility change, release-like barrier for the range (W->X publication per §11.2)
map.discard and reclaimable transitions: contents-affecting by declaration
recv/read-class: write their buffers per the effect table

intrinsic_binding.rule: the C-callable system-op surface is one generated header <lnp/intrinsics.h>, derived from this catalog (typed_operation_schemas for prototypes, compiler_semantics for effects/park/restart); names lnp_<family>_<function>; lnp_cap_t = uint64_t; conditions = negative intptr_t values. Hand-maintained bindings are nonconforming for psABI-claiming toolchains
intrinsic_binding.condition_representation: bare signed word: intptr_t, negative = -condition, non-negative = value (§13.1 niche layout); lnp_result_t single-word wrapper with lnp_ok/lnp_cond/lnp_value inline accessors; gate calls return the two-register {value, status} pair as a two-field struct whose accessor checks status, never value (§9.2)
intrinsic_binding.builder_transaction_idiom: __attribute__((cleanup(lnp_builder_abort))) on builder tokens; success consumes and nulls; abort is infallible (§16.1.1)
intrinsic_binding.builder_linearity: fail-closed at the machine: generation-threaded reference, violation -> -STALE at execution, never UB or authority confusion (§2.3). Two conforming tiers (psABI §5.3): token-typed frontend linearity, or plain integer SSA with runtime enforcement — the natural first-port shape
intrinsic_binding.failure_only_shape: callbr-shaped terminator: sole CFG successor = failure continuation, transfer path implicitly unreachable; failure edge is a normal edge, never unwind (no landing pad/personality/EH tables); failure-edge register contract: every register preserved except rd = negative condition (psABI §6)
intrinsic_binding.bundle_semantics: lnp.caps/moves/borrow are preserve-never-duplicate; transfer disposition (copy vs move) is a declared gate-interface fact verified at the callsite stub, so bundle loss is a verifier failure, never a silent copy-instead-of-move (psABI §5.2, object_format §5)

hwfail_producers.rule: closed producer set, frozen 2026-07-25 per the §13.1 evolution rule clause (i); -HWFAIL = executing machinery failed after acceptance, never referent corruption (-POISONED) or orderly abort (-CANCELLED)
hwfail_producers.delivery_note: wait/recv deliver records carrying it; they never produce it

view_withholdable_set.rule: closed, positively defined (§2.1): a MachineView may withhold only these; the system core (memory/mapping ops, typed objects, endpoints, futexes, gates, domain construction on own budget) is unconditional for every domain, forever
view_withholdable_set.self_capability_note: The complete §16.2 inalienable self-set—self-scoped subdivision, renunciation, inward/downward configuration, and self-fact observation—cannot be withheld by dself or MachineView policy; dself clearing CREATE is -MALFORMED. The same operations on explicit transferable capabilities remain governed by their ordinary droppable rights

cost_model.rule: every architected cost falls in exactly one class; anything not named in classes 2-4 is class 1 (flat) by default and by intent. A mechanism that cannot be placed in this table is mispriced by construction and must not land.
cost_model.protocol_verbs_note: named in Appendix C as choreography, not as entries in the opcode/typed-function namespace: AS_ENUMERATE is the §11.2 address-space enumeration protocol and RESERVATION is a class of admission analysis. Neither resolves to a decoded op.
cost_model.spec_name_aliases_note: Appendix C cites several ops in an uppercase protocol spelling while the catalog names them lowercase, and PagedBacking's own function names use three prefixing conventions at once (backing.new, clone, accessed.begin). This map is the reconciliation; it is the authority for cross-referencing the cost model, not a licence to respell either side.

provisional_assignments._note: Assigned 2026-07-27 by default reasoning because the ops scaled with a named input and Appendix C's fall-through would otherwise have priced them flat. Deliberately provisional: revisit with the floor-sizing/compiler audit. Removing this key is a claim that each row below has been confirmed, not that it was forgotten.
provisional_assignments.dreplace.commit: 3 - parametric in the prospective executable state published (§11.5); a configuration edit, never a runtime path
provisional_assignments.begin family: 4 - by the enumerated relation's cardinality and the caller's buffer, matching AS_ENUMERATE; cursor.next is class 1 (one record)

prose_token_allowlist.domain.abort: intrinsic shorthand for dabort (psABI intrinsic list)
prose_token_allowlist.get.active.lane.mask: LLVM intrinsic name cited without llvm. prefix
prose_token_allowlist.fcvtmod.w.d: assembler alias of fcvt.f2i mod form (§14)
prose_token_allowlist.window.faultable: named seam value (Appendix G PRI/PASID row)
prose_token_allowlist.decode.rd: machine-call payload field path (§9.3 restart recipe)

inalienable_self_set.ref: §16.2 (the closed mirror of §2.1's view-withholdable list; B36 is one instance)
inalienable_self_set.rule: operations whose object is the issuing domain itself and whose effect is to subdivide, shed, configure inward, or observe through the view are never deniable: no dself value, rights configuration, or view withholding reaches them; a dself value denying a member is -MALFORMED. Widen/cross/disclose operations stay granted
configure_inward: downward self-scheduling within the existing ceiling
deliberately_deniable: state.open on self (engine-metadata disclosure remains governed by dself)
irq/window/pmu construction (requires granted physical or device nouns)
composition_rules: shedding is never budget-blocked (net-releasing ops succeed at zero budget; a range split charges only its metadata)
fault-safety precedes leaf-freezing (§9.3 registrations established before the budget freeze; priced, never authority-deniable)

death_causes: unhandled fault whose escalation reaches a parentless Domain
root_death_reset.ordering: reset occurs after logical death and before reaping or descendant reparenting
root_death_reset.reset_effect: ordinary boot semantics: destroy all Domains and volatile engine state, restart measurements, and mint a fresh reset grant
root_death_reset.durability: only explicitly durable device/software state survives; no implicit checkpoint

canonical_operation_identity.rule: closure and generation compare (opcode,func); canonical names are unique decorations
